overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a quorum of Committee members attending a Select Board meeting did not deliberate, because two members spoke only about matters already discussed in posted meetings.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the School Committee deliberated outside a properly posted meeting when two members spoke at a Sept. 17, 2024 Select Board meeting attended by a quorum.
allegations.key_passage: However, their comments were limited to providing information on matters the Committee had already publicly discussed during properly posted meetings held on September 9 and September 16, 2024, and they did not convey any new opinions.
